title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Dolly Parton?
description: Three real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Dolly Parton, through the filmmaker Leni Riefenstahl and Mick Jagger.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Dolly Parton?
fun_fact: Dolly Parton wanted Mick Jagger to sing Satisfaction with her on her 2023 rock album, Rockstar. When he couldn't, P!nk and Brandi Carlile stepped in.
research_note: Leni Riefenstahl lived until 2003, and her own photo archive holds a snapshot of her arm in arm with Mick Jagger from the 1974 Sunday Times shoot of Mick and Bianca Jagger; three years later Jagger was backstage at Dolly Parton's Bottom Line show.

image.credit: Hinter den Kulissen des Reichsparteitag-Films (Munich, 1935), p. 32, via Internet Archive

links.line: In 1934, Hitler inspected the film setup in Nuremberg with filmmaker Leni Riefenstahl.
In 1974, Leni Riefenstahl photographed Rolling Stones singer Mick Jagger in London for The Sunday Times.
And in 1977, backstage in New York, Mick Jagger hugged Dolly Parton.
